cast.who: Nathaniel Yardley (the master's nephew and heir)
cast.note: Stands to become your master and knows you saw him cross the yard when he swears he was abed; he courts you, threatens you, and bargains with you across eleven nodes as his debts and the stable loft come closer to being spoken of aloud.

Wants the certificate signed and the body in the ice house with the widow's name clear of his own; he opens up to you about the master's health only when you ask as a servant, and closes again the moment you sound like an accuser.
Orders you about as the one person she can command without question, then shifts toward pleading as she realises you are the only one who might believe her and keep her in the house.

Treats your rounds as evidence and addresses you as a witness, drawing your account out in nine nodes while steering it away from the unsigned new will; his regard for you cools or hardens depending on what you let slip about the desk.
Reports the state of the road twice and wants only his fire; nothing about you changes how he acts.
